title: Postcards and Inventory
author: Quentin Quintana
blurb: Sable Brightwater, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent seven years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
